name: Privacy, Compliance, Retention, and Data Portability
description: Data classification, purpose and consent registry, local-only data boundaries, telemetry consent enforcement, content redaction, secret detection, encryption key lifecycle, retention rules, user data export, user data deletion, organization export, backup privacy, cross-border data controls, processor inventory, incident disclosure workflow, privacy threat modeling, and compliance evidence automation.
